title: Don_t_Layout
slide_intent: Reject competing entrances because viewers need a comprehensible order for reading a composition.
strategic_value: The overloaded counterexample can help DB teams judge the sequence independently of an otherwise correct final layout.
demonstration: The white-card employee composition uses overlapping or disordered arrivals and carries a cyan diagonal rejection line.
practical_value: Compare the order of events with DBV47; an acceptable final arrangement does not establish an acceptable animation.

content_islands.name: Competing entrances
content_islands.spec: Observe the card and contents arriving without the positive example’s clear sequence.

content_islands.name: Rejection mark
content_islands.spec: Keep the cyan diagonal source annotation visible throughout the negative example.
